text:
olivia: Heads up: prepping v1.8.0-private installer build for Acme Corp. Need signer handoff and a short deploybot pin window. ETA for QA gate: 09:30 PT.

deploy-bot: pinned request queued -> pin_id=pin-20260313-01; scheduled window 09:00-09:20 PT. Reaction :pushpin: 

sam: Can we shift to 09:05-09:15? QA needs an extra 5m for smoke tests.

maya: Packaging notes: build created -> `acme-installer-v1.8.0-rc3.tar.gz`
sha256: `b94f6f1252a3e1c9c4a6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a` (full hash in artifact metadata)
We ran the full installer validation on staging, all installers passed checksum and basic start/stop.

maya: Also added an image manifest: `images.json` with pinned tags for GPU and CPU runtime.

jack: I'll draft release notes for the customer-facing bundle doc. Will include upgrade steps and KMS signer thumbprint.

ops-lead: Rollback criteria proposal: if canary error rate >3% for 5 continuous minutes OR CPU throttling above 85% on dedicated nodes for 10m -> initiate rollback to `v1.7.9`.

olivia: @ops-lead agreed. Also add: if `manifest-sign` verification fails for any install attempt in first 50 hosts, abort and rollback.

deploy-bot: pin applied at 3130001260 -> `pin-20260313-01` -> pinned tag `v1.8.0-rc3-private` to canary ring.

packaging-bot: artifact publish event: `s3://releases/private/acme/1.8.0-rc3/` checksums uploaded.

sam: QA smoke results at 09:08 PT: 0 failures on 12 hosts, avg startup 21s. I'm clearing for canary.

ops-lead: starting canary rollout to 5% capacity now. Observability alert thresholds in place. Oncall: @olivia @sam.

olivia: watching logs and metrics. If anything odd ping oncall and ping this thread. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: canary reached 5% at 3130001280. Health OK.

olivia: thanks. jack once release notes are in, send the signed manifest to the customer and cc @ops-lead.

jack: will do, drafting now.

olivia: follow-up: if stable for 30m we'll expand to 50% then full. Rollback playbook: `docs/onprem/rollback_playbook.md` — ops-lead confirmed.

ops-lead: confirmed. I'll open a post-deploy checklist and capture timings.

olivia: closing this thread for deployment coordination. I'll open a final signoff thread after 60m. :white_check_mark:
